But note two points: (1) formatting may shift line numbers, making error stacks mismatch old logs, so commit formatting changes separately in git; (2) ASCII diagrams and aligned text in comments get rearranged, so check them afterward.

map.压缩：逐行去掉首尾空白；连续空行只保留一个；注释行原样输出；三引号字符串内的行不: Compression: trim each line; keep only one of consecutive blank lines; output comment lines as-is; lines inside triple-quoted strings do not participate in merging. Merge criterion — if the previous line, after removing comments, does not end with :, the original line does not end with : \ ( [ { ,, and the current line does not start with else / elif / except / finally and does not match ^\w+: then the current line is appended to the end of the previous line with "; ". Validation: after stripping comments and strings, a line ending with : increments the nesting depth and updates the maximum depth; a line starting with return / break / continue / pass / raise decrements depth without going below 0; else: / elif: / except: / finally: do not change the depth. Indentation uses a tab or the specified number of spaces per the option
